Through Customer Insights, CSUSM will establish a connection with every student, accompanying them on their journey from prospective students to successful CSUSM scholars, and eventually as alumni making a significant difference in their communities and careers. Nestled in the foothills of northern San Diego County, California State University San Marcos (CSUSM) stands out among its 22 sister CSU campuses for its impressive growth in enrollment, particularly at a time when many institutions nationwide are grappling with declining numbers.
